command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; ls docs

cd /app; cat tests/test_fees.py; cd data; cat policy.ini branches.csv calendar.csv; head -5 patrons.csv waivers.csv; cat exports/manifest.txt; head -3 exports/har-2026-12-28.csv exports/wst-2027-01-22.jsonl exports/resend-cen.csv; ls exports | grep -v -E '^[a-z]{3}-20'; cat ../tools/check_fees.py | head -50
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/fees.py data out/statements.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -20; python tools/check_fees.py

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/fees.py following the documented rules and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/statements.json. The unit tests pass and check_fees.py matches all 228 statements and 4 branch rows."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
